title: Ryusei Species
description: Add 19 species and some thing for you, I thnk you should try it at least once
body:
Ryusei's Species is a data pack which add 20 op species to your world.

## Use this command "**/trigger Choose_Species**" and type "**/trigger <species you want>**"

Human : They are the hero of the village and very luck, they can use andrenalin if their hp is low

Apolian : They are strong where have the light but in the dark they are weak, they can give fire_aspect to sword which they're holding

Dracula : Strong in dark and burned under the sunshine but some mob like iron golem will attack you

Monster : They are friend of zombie, skeleton, creeper,... but some mob like iron golem will attack you

Outsider : They can be invisibility if they are sneaking but they can gain a bit damage because when they be invisibility their heart will stop beating

Enderian : They can teleport when sneaking but their main hand must empty and they can teleport any mobs they attacked to some where and mark the creatures they attack with a glowing effect, they are friend of enderman

Televisian : They can teleport when sneaking with black fog and give blindness to some mob near them, they also can give slow and mining fatigue enimies which they attack but their main hand must empty and they can't be slowness, they can die in the water

Brickcat : With a brick they can be strong

Orc : The strongest species, elder guardian, guardian and warden are their friend but they are slow

Dwarf : They have the fastest block breaking speed and can give efficiency V to pickaxe or axe which they are holding

Elf : They are the fastest species, they can enchant bow, cross bow, mace, they also can summon wind charge if sneak and holding bow, cross bow or mace(Cooldown 10 seconds to summon the next wind charge)

Electrian : They can summon lightning bolt to any mobs they attacked and mark the creatures they attack with a glowing effect

Pillager : They can summon evoker fang to any mobs they attacked and give on creature which they attacked poison effect and enchant crossbow but some mob like iron golem will attack you

Fishman : They will be slow unless they are in the water and be strong and fast in the water and they can enchant their trident

Fireman : They will be slow in snowy biomes and can die in the water, they can summon fireball if sneaking and holding a flint and steel or fire charge (Cooldown 10 seconds to summon the next fireball), they can melt ice

Frostman : They never starve and they can freeze water, they can die in desert biome, in nether, fire or lava but they can be fast and strong in the snowy biomes, they can slow mobs 5 blocks away from the player

Lycanthrope : At night they are strong but in the morning they like the normal human and marks creatures with a glowing effect by sneak

Mecha : They will be slow in snowy biomes and they strong, they can summon fireball if sneaking and holding a flint and steel or fire charge (Cooldown 10 seconds to summon the next fireball), but they depend on their food level, they can "recharge" when stand on a redstone block

Spiderian : They can climb wall when sneak near a climbale block and use potionnous ball

Cultivator: They can be Demonic Cultivator or Xianxia Cultivator dependon their karma
 + Demonic and Xianxia Cultivator : not different too much but Xianxia Cultivator can recovery energy faster than Demonic
_________________
Something else:
* Batery : you can craft it and eat but only Mecha can use it
* Self-Destruct button: if Mecha holding it they will be explosion
* Hide in grass: if you are standing in tall grass, suger cane,...
* Anti hide helmet: wear it and some is hiding in grass can't be hide (including you)
* Grilled Flesh : grill rotten flesh by furnace, smoker or campfire to make it
* Potionless Pufferfish : It can make by using furnace or smoker
